```{python}
# Task 15
run_sql_and_return_html(cnx,"""
SELECT
  country_region,
  SUM(CASE WHEN country_income_category = 'High income' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS High,
  SUM(CASE WHEN country_income_category = 'Upper middle income' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Upper_Middle,
  SUM(CASE WHEN country_income_category = 'Lower middle income' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Lower_Middle,
  SUM(CASE WHEN country_income_category = 'Low income' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Low,
  SUM(CASE WHEN country_income_category IS NULL OR country_income_category = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Unknown,
  COUNT(*) AS Total
FROM wdi_country
GROUP BY country_region;
""")
```

```{python}
# Task 16

FROM wdi_country

GROUP BY country_region, country_income_category
ORDER BY low_income_count DESC
LIMIT 1;
""")
```

```{python}
# Task 17
run_sql_and_return_html(cnx,"""
SELECT country_code, country_short_name, country_region, country_income_category
FROM wdi_country

    SELECT country_region FROM wdi_country WHERE country_code = 'MHL'
)
AND country_income_category = (
    SELECT country_income_category FROM wdi_country WHERE country_code = 'MHL'
)
ORDER BY country_short_name;
""")
```

```{python}
# Task 18
run_sql_and_return_html(cnx,"""
WITH regions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT country_region FROM wdi_country
),
incomes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT country_income_category FROM wdi_country
),
combos AS (
  SELECT r.country_region, i.country_income_category
  FROM regions r CROSS JOIN incomes i
),
actuals AS (
  SELECT country_region, country_income_category
  FROM wdi_country
  GROUP BY country_region, country_income_category
)
SELECT c.*
FROM combos c
LEFT JOIN actuals a
ON c.country_region = a.country_region AND c.country_income_category = a.country_income_category
WHERE a.country_region IS NULL;
""")
```

```{python}
# Task 19
run_sql_and_return_html(cnx,"""
WITH base AS (
  SELECT country_region, country_income_category, COUNT(*) AS count
  FROM wdi_country
  GROUP BY country_region, country_income_category
),
region_totals AS (
  SELECT country_region, SUM(count) AS region_total
  FROM base
  GROUP BY country_region
),
income_totals AS (
  SELECT country_income_category, SUM(count) AS income_total
  FROM base
  GROUP BY country_income_category
),
total_sum AS (
  SELECT SUM(count) AS total_countries FROM base
)
SELECT
  b.country_region,
  b.country_income_category,
  b.count,
  r.region_total,
  i.income_total,
  t.total_countries,
  ROUND((b.count * 100.0 / t.total_countries), 2) AS percent_of_total
FROM base b
JOIN region_totals r ON b.country_region = r.country_region
JOIN income_totals i ON b.country_income_category = i.country_income_category
JOIN total_sum t;
""")
```

```{python}
# Task 20
run_sql_and_return_html(cnx,"""
WITH base AS (
  SELECT country_region, country_income_category, COUNT(*) AS count
  FROM wdi_country
  GROUP BY country_region, country_income_category
),
total_sum AS (
  SELECT SUM(count) AS total_countries FROM base
)
SELECT
  country_region,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN country_income_category = 'High income' THEN count ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / total_countries, 2) AS High,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN country_income_category = 'Upper middle income' THEN count ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / total_countries, 2) AS Upper_Middle,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN country_income_category = 'Lower middle income' THEN count ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / total_countries, 2) AS Lower_Middle,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN country_income_category = 'Low income' THEN count ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / total_countries, 2) AS Low,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN country_income_category IS NULL OR country_income_category = '' THEN count ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / total_countries, 2) AS Unknown
FROM base, total_sum
GROUP BY country_region, total_countries;
""")
```

```{python}
# Task 21
run_sql_and_return_html(cnx,"""
WITH base AS (
  SELECT country_income_category, COUNT(*) AS count
  FROM wdi_country
  GROUP BY country_income_category
),
total AS (
  SELECT SUM(count) AS total_count FROM base
)
SELECT
  b.country_income_category,
  b.count,
  t.total_count,
  ROUND(b.count * 100.0 / t.total_count, 2) AS percent_of_total
FROM base b, total t;
""")
```
